1208	  state: "active" | "accepted" | "expired" | "revoked" | undefined,
1209	) {
1210	  const now = new Date();
1211	  switch (state) {
1212	    case "active":
1213	      return and(
1214	        isNull(invites.revokedAt),
1215	        isNull(invites.acceptedAt),
1216	        gt(invites.expiresAt, now),
1217	      );
1218	    case "accepted":
1219	      return isNotNull(invites.acceptedAt);
1220	    case "expired":
1221	      return and(
1222	        isNull(invites.revokedAt),
1223	        isNull(invites.acceptedAt),
1224	        lte(invites.expiresAt, now),
1225	      );
1226	    case "revoked":
1227	      return isNotNull(invites.revokedAt);
1228	    default:
1229	      return undefined;
1230	  }
